use default
use Ghul.Comparable

merge_two[T: Comparable[T]](left: Iterable[T],
                            right: Iterable[T]) -> Pipe[T]
is
    let ahead = left.iterator
    let behind = right.iterator
    let more_ahead mut = ahead.move_next()
    let more_behind mut = behind.move_next()

    while more_ahead /\ more_behind do
        if ahead.current <= behind.current then
            yield ahead.current

            more_ahead = ahead.move_next()
        else
            yield behind.current

            more_behind = behind.move_next()
        fi
    od

    while more_ahead do
        yield ahead.current

        more_ahead = ahead.move_next()
    od

    while more_behind do
        yield behind.current

        more_behind = behind.move_next()
    od
si

merge_all[T: Comparable[T]](streams: List[Iterable[T]]) -> Pipe[T] =>
    case streams.count
    when 0 then pipe(LIST[T]())
    when 1 then pipe(streams[0])
    else
        let middle = streams.count / 2 in
        merge_two(merge_all(streams[0..middle]),
                  merge_all(streams[middle..<0]))
    esac

counting(start: int, step: int, count: int) -> Pipe[int] is
    for term in 0..count do
        yield start + term * step
    od
si

let pair = merge_two(counting(0, 3, 4), counting(1, 3, 4))

write_line("two streams:")
write_line("  {pair |> join(" ")}")

let streams =
    [counting(0, 3, 4), counting(1, 3, 4), counting(2, 3, 4)] |> collect()

write_line("three streams:")
write_line("  {merge_all(streams) |> join(" ")}")

write_line("nothing to merge:")
write_line("  [{merge_all(LIST[Iterable[int]]()) |> join(" ")}]")

let words =
    [pipe(["apple", "cherry", "grape"]), pipe(["banana", "date"])]
        |> collect()

write_line("two streams of words:")
write_line("  {merge_all(words) |> join(" ")}")
